exposure: baseline plasma brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) levels
cohort: The study included 71 women diagnosed with peripartum cardiomyopathy (PPCM) who were admitted to Beijing Friendship Hospital between 2004 and 2011.
finding: LVEF < 34% and BNP > 1860 pg/mL were identified as independent prognostic factors for predicting persistent left ventricular systolic dysfunction in PPCM patients.
